The '''2014–15 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Arkansas]] in the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team's [[head coach]] was [[Mike Anderson (basketball, born 1959)|Mike Anderson]]. The team played their home games at [[Bud Walton Arena]] in [[Fayetteville, Arkansas]], as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]]. They finished the season 27–9, 13–5 in SEC play to finish in second place. They advanced to the championship game of the [[2015 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] where they lost to [[2014–15 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2014–15 Wofford Terriers men's basketball team|Wofford]] in the round of 64 before losing to [[2014–15 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] in the round of 32.

==Preseason==
Coach Mike Anderson completed his third season by posting a 22-12 record during the [[2013-14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2013-14 season]], where the Razorbacks finished fifth in the SEC. The Razorbacks participated in the [[2014 NIT|NIT]], where they defeated [[2014–15 Indiana State Sycamores men's basketball team|Indiana State]] at home before losing to [[2014–15 California Golden Bears men's basketball team|California]] on the road.
